title: polygala vulgaris subsp. alpestris
intro: Polygala vulgaris subsp. alpestris, commonly known as Alpestris or Alpine Polygala, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the milkwort family (Polygalaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine to promote health and well-being, particularly in the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The health benefits of Polygala vulgaris subsp. alpestris include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant actions, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions.
